extra.question: Find the full name, Wiki Pedia page link, and date of birth of German drivers born between 1971 and 1985. List it in descending order of date of birth.
extra.evidence: FFull name refers to forname+surname; Nationality refers to German; Date of birth refers to dob; year(dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985'
extra.question_with_evidence: Find the full name, Wiki Pedia page link, and date of birth of German drivers born between 1971 and 1985. List it in descending order of date of birth. Hint: FFull name refers to forname+surname; Nationality refers to German; Date of birth refers to dob; year(dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985'
extra.SQL: SELECT forename, surname, url, dob FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' AND STRFTIME('%Y', dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985' ORDER BY dob DESC
